title: 概率焦点搜索：通过下界推进加速有界次优搜索
summary: 提出概率焦点搜索（PFS），以概率p遵循焦点搜索的启发式引导，以概率1-p扩展最小f节点以推进下界、扩大FOCAL集合。在N-Puzzle、煎饼排序和TSP上，当f_min长期停滞时可减少约90%以上节点扩展；其任意时间扩展APFS在GCTSP上表现最佳。
summary_en: Introduces Probabilistic Focal Search (PFS), which follows Focal Search's guided choice with probability p and expands a minimum-f node with probability 1-p to advance the lower bound and enlarge FOCAL. On N-Puzzle, Pancake Sorting, and TSP, it can cut node expansions by ~90%+ when f_min plateaus delay useful FOCAL admissions; its anytime extension APFS outperforms all tested algorithms on GCTSP.
